about: HASS-CHAOS-1 drunk-owner cases. Each case: id, feature, expect (what the spec and G's goals say should happen), turns, checks, known. Turn fields: text ({code} = newest draft code, {old_code} = first draft code), photos (names in photos/), gap_minutes (default 1), stranger, kind, max_replies (default 1; stranger 0), min_replies (default 1), has_any, lacks, disposition, max_seconds. Case checks: commits (default 0 = nothing published), public_lacks, public_has. known: {check id: finding id} for failures that are product bugs already in FIX-PLAN.md; a known check that starts passing prints 'fixed'.

expect: '?' after a listing re-sends the card or explains; never treated as approval.
'yes <code>' publishes exactly once.
Bare 'yes' publishes nothing and says to add the code.
'yes 9999' (wrong code) publishes nothing; says which code is waiting.
Code with a typo/extra letter publishes nothing.
'YES <CODE>' in capitals publishes once (case-insensitive) - or asks; never publishes twice.
'yes please!' / 'looks good' never publishes; says the code is needed.
Approving after an edit uses the current version only; if the code stayed the same, the edited version is published (price $4).
Two different products waiting; 'yes <first code>' publishes only the first.
'yes <code>' 2 hours later (ttl 1 h) publishes nothing and offers 'again <code>'.
Silence for an hour then 'ok': never publishes; says what is waiting (or that it expired).
'no' cancels the waiting listing; nothing published.
After publishing, 'make it $4' drafts a price change to the published product (new code), not a new product.
Same 'yes <code>' sent twice publishes once; second reply says it's already done.
After a publish, 'undo' drafts the reversal (needs its own yes); nothing else changes.
An EDITED message 'yes <code>' (iMessage edit) is never read as approval.
'how many glue left' (not on the till) says it can't find glue on the till; no draft.
'how many hass avocados do we have' answers from the till cache.

turns.text: how many hass avocados do we have
